definition: a secret plan to trick someone
description: A narrow hallway in an old flat with dark red walls, a wooden floor and a bicycle. A young woman in a burgundy hoodie and shorts stands on a wooden chair and balances a metal bucket full of water and ice on top of a half-open door. A young man crouches beside the chair, holding it steady with his finger on his lips. A young woman in a mustard top comes down the hall laughing and hurries out of view. The first woman jumps down, and both crouch by the chair, grinning and watching the door.

en.question: What is the woman in red balancing?
